There is so much misinformation out there about VA loans.

Here’s what’s true:
✅ You don’t need a down payment
✅ You don’t pay monthly mortgage insurance
✅ You can use it more than once
✅ It is assumable in many cases

What matters most is having the right strategy and the right team behind you.

If you’re military or a veteran in Central Texas and have questions, we’re here to serve you the way you served us.

📩 Message us “VA” and we’ll walk you through your options step by step.
